title: Unexpected exception inside a component
cause: An exception was thrown from BobsComponents code and matched no more specific rule.
fix: This is a bug in the library. Report the error id with the component name and the stack trace from the Details section.

title: Required parameter missing
message: {component}: required parameter '{parameter}' was not set. Expected {expected}.
cause: A parameter marked required was not passed to the component.
fix: Pass the parameter, for example <Component Parameter="..." />.

title: Parameter value invalid
cause: The value passed is outside what the component accepts.
fix: Pass a value that matches the expectation named in the message.

title: Parameters conflict
cause: Two parameters were set to a combination the component does not support.
fix: Remove one of the two parameters or change its value as the message describes.

title: Data shape mismatch
message: Data shape mismatch at '{path}': expected {expected}, got {actual}.
cause: A value at the given path was missing or had a different type than the component needs.
fix: Fix the data source or map it into the type the component takes.

title: Deserialization failed
cause: JSON could not be turned into the target type. The path in the details is where it failed.
fix: Compare the JSON at that path with the target type and correct one of them.

title: Script or JS function not found
message: Script or JS function '{script}' could not be loaded or called.
cause: A static web asset under _content/BobsComponents/ was not served, or a JavaScript function it exports does not exist.
fix: Make sure the host serves static web assets (UseStaticFiles in Development, or a published site), the base href is correct, and the package is the version the app expects.

title: Service not registered
cause: A component asked for a service that was never added to dependency injection.
fix: Call builder.Services.AddBobComponents() in Program.cs, or register the service named in the message.

title: Server returned an error status
cause: The server answered with a non-success status code.
fix: Read the status and message shown; they come from the server. Check the request URL and body in the dev kit Network panel.

title: Request failed before a response
cause: The request never got a response: offline, DNS failure, connection refused, or blocked by CORS.
fix: Check connectivity, the URL, and the server's CORS settings.

title: Request timed out
cause: The server did not answer within the HttpClient timeout.
fix: Check the server, or raise HttpClient.Timeout if the call is legitimately slow.

title: Your callback threw
cause: An EventCallback you passed to the component, or other app code running in the component's render path, threw.
fix: The Details section lists your top stack frame. Fix the exception there; the component itself is working.

title: Your render fragment threw
cause: A RenderFragment you passed to the component threw while rendering.
fix: The Details section lists your top stack frame. Fix the exception in the fragment's markup or code.
